original_test_intent: Verify the complete SMBIOS Type 0 BIOS Characteristics capability set matches the approved platform/firmware feature bitmap and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Archive raw Type 0, parse the entire indented Characteristics list or underlying bitmap rather than one line, compare normalized capabilities and reserved/unknown bits with the platform baseline, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the feature baseline and unchanged reboot plan. Multi-line collection, normalization and comparison are automatable.
safety_requirements: Preserve raw record and errors; do not use one-line grep as complete evidence.
Do not infer required capabilities from whichever strings current dmidecode decodes.
Stop on unknown/reserved bit policy violation, capability drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw Type 0/tool identity, parse the complete characteristic set, retain unknowns, compare with the approved bitmap before/after reboot.
Do not modify firmware, silently discard unknown bits or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve required/optional/prohibited feature semantics and reserved-bit policy.
Interpret discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not complete: `grep -A1` cannot capture a variable-length indented list and `BIOS Characteristics` may not be the rendered label; stderr suppression and insecure SSH assumptions are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 0 with version/errors and parse the Characteristics block to the next peer field or record boundary.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, Characteristics scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare both decoded feature names and the raw/derived characteristic bitmap, preserve unknown/reserved bits and bind decoding to SMBIOS/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS feature baseline and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces fragile one-line filtering with complete bitset-aware comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; it captures all capabilities rather than the first line.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Decoded names can change across dmidecode versions; raw bit preservation prevents false drift.

project_override_considerations: A project may classify characteristics as required, optional or prohibited. The exact matrix/version must be recorded and cannot alter Master Source.
expected_evidence: Approval, feature/bit baseline, platform identity and tool version
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 plus full normalized set

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently define Characteristics validation; feature expectations are project data.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and evidence path are clear; missing baseline/package/window is readiness only.

review_improvement: Prevents silent omission of all but one characteristic and guards against decoder-version wording changes.
